deliverables: The K parameter was created to limit the total number of ADA staked to one pool.
The K parameter determines the saturation of stakepools.
To calculate the saturation of stakepools you can take the total number of ADA and divide it by K.
K is currently 500, and pool saturation is currently 74,551,771.86 ADA.
